declaration_rule.text: an effect is declared only if its 95% document-bootstrap percentile interval excludes 0 AND |effect| > 2 x the non-determinism floor

split.rule: every nuisance choice (calibrators, knots, ell bins, temperatures, the f(ell) offset of Eq. 2/3, C3) comes from the fit half; every reported number, and the coefficients and curves behind it (beta_z, gamma, the E3 type terms, ECE bin edges), is estimated on the report half
split.tasks: scripts/make_task_split.py: the same document_split and seed

floors.rule: one floor per model family, measured on the Base checkpoint (20 reserve documents x 5 repeats, t2-pilot design); the Instruct arms use their family's

outcomes.fewer_8b_settings: 1,000 < N <= 2,000: use all 2,000 documents on fewer 8B settings
outcomes.shift_to_110m_and_c2: N > 2,000: even the whole corpus is underpowered; shift weight to the 110M model and C2

G1.taken_on: max N over mask arms and the two primary contrasts

G2.rule: the metric is flat over the last tail_fraction of training

primary_endpoints.E1: Delta(32) - Delta(1), Delta(m) = E_m[conf - agree] over pool winners, document-first
primary_endpoints.E2: field(32) - field(1), field(m) = E_m[pi_hat(l) - pi_hat(l, s)]

holm_families.E1_contrast: Delta(32) - Delta(1) across models x datasets
holm_families.E2_field_contrast: field(32) - field(1) across models x datasets

e3.model: a ~ alpha_rate_bin + f(ell) + type + f(ell) x type, f a restricted cubic spline (knots from the fit half), pool weights within each arm

references.secondary: uniform grid, reweighted to the decoder arm's rate-bin mix

e3.endpoint: type effect E_dec[pi_ref(l) - pi_dec(l)] (> 0: decoder states more overconfident at equal confidence)
e3.joint_test: sup-t test that the difference curve is zero (c3.endpoints.e3.sup_t)

t8.rows: E1 Delta(32) - Delta(1) and E2 field(32) - field(1), without and with each control, and their paired difference, on one resample matrix

position.with: Delta - E_m[pi(l) - pi(l, x)]; field with x in both calibrators

temperature.primary: logodds: c = sigma(ell / T_bin), fitted by the NLL of correctness (exact from the trace)
temperature.sensitivity: softmax: logits / T rebuilt from the top-20 and an even tail, fitted by true-token NLL

precision.comparison: LLaDA-8B-Base fp16 vs 4-bit NF4, same documents; E1, E2, beta_z (paired resamples) and the paired logit shift

contamination.rule: flag a document whose greedy 50-token continuation of its 50-token prefix matches the true text for a run of at least the threshold; report every FineWeb endpoint with and without flagged documents
contamination.deviation: the threshold was fixed in code after the 29 Sep screens were seen (prereg/deviations.md)

settled_by.holm_families, context_calibrator, task_: abhiraj's proposal 20261023T141455Z-abhiraj-2a71 (23 Oct), no objection by its Sat 24 Oct 18:00 IST deadline

settled_by.note: the 25 Oct choices postdate the 24 Oct report-half exposure (prereg/deviations.md 16); none depends on data

settled.holm_families: E1 Delta(32)-Delta(1) and E2 field(32)-field(1), each across the models x datasets arms of analysis_commands.sh on uniform and decoder:topk_conf:k4; decoder k = 2, 8 and uniform_matched exploratory; the contamination-clean and time-split runs are robustness checks outside the families; gamma_2..gamma_4 Holm within each arm
settled.context_calibrator: the interacted form (ell x field features, the code default); plan v2 T6(2)'s additive form is the sensitivity check (the <label>_additive runs, E1/E2 only)
settled.t8_temperature: log-odds per mask-rate bin, c = sigma(ell / T), is the primary row; softmax (top-20 plus an even tail) is a sensitivity row
settled.claim_rule: an E1 or E2 effect in a Holm family is claimed only if it is declared (c3.stats.declare: interval excludes 0 and |effect| > 2 x floor) AND rejected by Holm within its family at alpha = 0.05; with every floor 0 the floor half is vacuous, so this equals the Holm rejection alone. Each family's size is fixed at every label x primary arm (7 x 2 = 14); a missing member or non-finite p counts as p = 1. scripts/summarize_c1.py applies both halves (field 'claimed') and stars only claimed effects. beta_z (Eq. 2, with and without state FE) is a diagnostic: reported with its interval, outside the Holm families, never a claim. Effects outside the families (other decoder arms, uniform_matched, E3, T8, clean and time-split runs) are reported with their intervals and labelled exploratory; gamma_2..gamma_4 use Holm within each arm
settled.eq23_bootstrap: 1,000 resamples in the primary run and the T8 precision beta_z, 200 in the knot runs, none in the contamination-clean, time-split and additive-calibrator runs (prereg/deviations.md 15)
